tools.name: risk_reward
tools.description: Reward:risk ratio, breakeven win rate, and expectancy in R multiples from an entry, stop and target.

tools.name: position_size
tools.description: Lot size, units and per-lot pip value from account risk, a stop distance, and an instrument.

tools.name: pip_value
tools.description: Cash value of one pip/point for a given instrument, lot size and account currency.

tools.name: margin
tools.description: Notional value, required margin, and effective leverage for a leveraged position.

tools.name: profit_loss
tools.description: Cash result, pips, and return-on-margin for a closed or hypothetical trade.

tools.name: compounding
tools.description: Account growth curve, total return and the gain from compounding vs. simple interest.

tools.name: pivot_points
tools.description: Classic, Fibonacci, Camarilla and Woodie support/resistance levels from a prior high, low and close.

tools.name: fibonacci_levels
tools.description: Retracement (0-100%) and extension (127.2-261.8%) price levels for a swing high/low.

tools.name: liquidation_price
tools.description: Estimated liquidation price and distance from entry for a leveraged crypto position.

tools.name: rmd
tools.description: This year's RMD from a prior-year-end IRA/employer-plan balance and age, per the IRS Uniform Lifetime Table.

tools.name: ibond_value
tools.description: Accrued and redeemable value of a Series I savings bond, from its issue month, face value and an as-of month.

tools.name: financial_health_score
tools.description: A 0-100 score from savings rate, emergency fund coverage and debt-to-income, each against a named benchmark.

tools.name: real_wage
tools.description: Whether a pay change kept pace with inflation, in real (inflation-adjusted) terms, using annual US CPI.

tools.name: emergency_fund
tools.description: How many months of runway a set of resources covers against monthly expenses, net of unemployment benefits and COBRA.

tools.name: coast_fire
tools.description: The amount invested today that, growing alone with no further contributions, reaches a full FIRE number by retirement age.

tools.name: inflation_adjust
tools.description: What a dollar amount in one year is worth in another year's dollars, based on annual US CPI-U.

tools.name: fx_rate
tools.description: Daily ECB reference cross rate between two currencies.

tools.name: cpi_index
tools.description: The annual (yearly-average) US CPI-U index value for a given year.
